A new survey released Thursday shows more Missourians disapprove of President Donald Trump and Gov. Mike Kehoe’s job performance than approve.

For Trump, it is the first negative approval rating in the six-year history of the St. Louis University/YouGov poll. For Kehoe, it is the first since he took office last year.

Trump has lost 19 percentage points in net approval since he took office at the start of 2025 — including 14 points since February. [...] The SLU YouGov poll surveyed 900 likely voters between Aug. 13 and Aug. 24 and results have a margin of error of about 4%. The SLU YouGov poll was initiated in June 2020 and the August poll is the 11th time for the survey of Missouri voters.

# Trump poll finds most states disapprove of his job performance

Portrait of Natassia Paloma

Most states disapprove of President Donald Trump’s job performance, including Texas.

According to an approval tracker from The Economist and YouGov, Trump’s net job approval rating in Texas is -22, meaning his disapproval rating is 22 percentage points higher than his approval rating.

Texas is far from alone. [...] The tracker shows 47 of the 50 states with negative net approval ratings for Trump. Only three states have positive net approval ratings for the president: Wyoming at +14, Idaho at +9 and West Virginia at +6. All three went for Trump in the 2016, 2020, and 2020 presidential elections,

Each week, YouGov invites around 1,500 members of its opt-in panel to complete an online questionnaire. The respondents are selected to be representative of American adult citizens and the data is weighted to represent the country according to gender, age, race, education and voting behaviour. To track the results of YouGov’s polling over time, The Economist aggregates survey data each week and fits a line of best fit.
